data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to copy images to the system clipboard on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Enables developers to copy images directly to the system clipboard on Android and iOS devices. Simplifies sharing and integrating image data with other applications and services.
use_when: You need to allow users to copy images to the system clipboard on mobile devices.
You want an easy way to move image data out of your Flutter app via the clipboard.
avoid_when: You are targeting web, desktop, or platforms other than Android and iOS.
You need to retrieve or paste images from the clipboard rather than just copying them.
strengths: Provides straightforward image copying functionality for Android and iOS.
Very easy to integrate with a simple function call.
weaknesses: Limited to Android and iOS mobile platforms only.
Does not support reading or pasting images from the clipboard, only copying.
No documented support for web or desktop.
